%hive
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campanhas_juan (
    number_id STRING,
    id_campaign STRING,
    type_campaign STRING,
    days_valid STRING, 
    data_campaign STRING,
    channel STRING,
    return_status STRING,
    return_date STRING,
    client_id STRING
)
ROW FORMAT DELIMITED 
FIELDS TERMINATED BY ","
STORED AS TEXTFILE

%hive
LOAD DATA INPATH 's3a://desafio01/campaigns_2023_hist.csv'
INTO TABLE campanhas_juan

%hive
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_valores_nulos,
        
       COUNT(CASE WHEN id_campaign IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS nulos_coluna1,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN type_campaign IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS nulos_coluna2,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN days_valid IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS nulos_coluna3,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN data_campaign IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS nulos_coluna4,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN channel IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS nulos_colun5,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN return_status IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS nulos_coluna6,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN return_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS nulos_coluna7,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN client_id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS nulos_coluna8
FROM campanhas_juan

SELECT 
    id_campaign,
    YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(data_campaign, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) AS ano,
    MONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(data_campaign, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) AS mes,

    campanhas_juan

    YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(data_campaign, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))),
    MONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(data_campaign, 'yyyy-MM-dd')))
ORDER BY 
    id_campaign, ano, mes

%hive
SELECT 
    id_campaign,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM data_campaign) AS ano,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM data_campaign) AS mes,
    AVG(COALESCE(register_acess, 0)) AS media_acessos
FROM 
    campanhas_juan
GROUP BY 
    id_campaign, 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM data_campaign),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM data_campaign)
ORDER BY 
    id_campaign, ano, mes

%hive
SELECT 
    id_campaign,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM data_campaign) AS ano,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM data_campaign) AS mes,
    AVG(CAST(register_acess AS INT)) AS media_acessos
FROM 
    campanhas_juan
WHERE 
    register_acess IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    id_campaign, 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM data_campaign),
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM data_campaign)
ORDER BY 
    id_campaign, ano, mes
